text: Independent games made with AI. All playable in your browser. Not your thing? Try another three. Play opens the creator’s site in a new tab. Every game opens in a browser. Device icons show where to play; controller badges appear when support is confirmed. Try a different search or loosen your filters. Shikhar’s web-swinging city is one to explore. The creator shares the code and local setup instructions; a public browser build is unconfirmed. By Shikhar ↗ · Creator’s screenshot ↗ A NOTE FROM RICH I built Playground to help you find brilliant games. Your tips help me keep discovering more and keep the site free to browse. Add your game to Playground. Free to submit, reviewed before it goes live. Share a game you made with AI. Every submission is reviewed before it appears on Playground. Open each game, check its cover, details and content, then approve or reject it. Approved games appear immediately. Player ratings and reviews publish immediately. You can remove or restore them here. A suggestion, a broken link, or something else? Send me a message. Private messages sent through Playground. THE FIRST COLLECTION Playground brings independent browser games into one place, with a genre, creator credit, and a link to play. Games made with any AI model are welcome. This is a growing collection of browser games, with new discoveries added regularly. Model labels follow creator or source attributions. Listings link back to their evidence, and covers show the actual games. Most played counts outbound play clicks, with one counted per browser per game per day. A browser cookie limits repeat play counts and remembers your rating so changing it updates your vote. You can rate directly on a game’s stars without providing an email. Ratings and reviews publish immediately and update game rankings. Removed reviews do not count towards ratings. Contact emails are private and used for moderation, replies and duplicate checks. Messages sent through the contact form are stored privately for Rich. FormSubmit processes a copy to forward it to his email inbox. We use Cloudflare Web Analytics to understand visits, referral sources and site performance. It does not use tracking cookies. Some games need a keyboard, mouse, or a recent browser. Links can change; inclusion is not a full gameplay review.
